evidence.note: Bar chart on a 0-100% axis shows Q2 2026 on-time share for Network (86%), 12 Cross-town (85%), 14 Cross-town (85%) and Other six median (87%).
Q3 bars build in beside each Q2 bar: Network 81%, 12 Cross-town 70%, 14 Cross-town 74%, Other six 87%; the cross-town bars visibly drop further than the network bar while the other six stay level.
Added paragraph 'The two cross-town routes through the roadworks fell furthest; the other six routes held.' restates what the bar pair heights already show.
A Target 90% line is added across the chart; context, not part of the title's claim.
Insight card states the two routes account for almost all of the network's fall; the chart behind is blurred.
Point drops are not drawn as deltas; the viewer must subtract the bar labels (85 to 70 reads as 15, against the title's 14) to get the title's figures.

rationale: The paired Q2/Q3 bars show the evidence directly: the two cross-town routes drop far more than the network while the other six hold, so prose is not needed to see the claim. The exact point falls in the title still have to be worked out from the bar labels, and the step-1 paragraph repeats what the bars show. That fits level 4: the visual carries the evidence, with text adding labels, minor detail and some restatement.
